collection.title: VW Multivan T5 2003 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Multivan T5 2003 to 2012 model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Side Pin arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this Multivan, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
